note: *Não a nós, Senhor, não a nós* is the one familiar head, kept without *ó*; the second half is the imperative *dai glória*, where the CNBB has the wish *seja a glória*.
*Os ídolos das nações*, against *simulacros*; the option keeps the Latin's word.
*ele é o auxílio deles*: the Latinist asked *auxiliador* twice; held, as with *adjútor* throughout (HANDOFF).
